items.name: G_boombap_battle
items.prompt: Playful old-school boom bap hip hop instrumental for a cute street dance battle. 94 BPM, punchy kick and crisp snare, swinging hi-hats, warm deep bassline, funky horn stab hook and short vinyl scratch accents, confident and cheeky, catchy and loopable, steady energy from the first beat.
